newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Travel closes US$150mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: China Travel closes US$150mln FRN.

text.p: China Travel Service (Holdings) Hong Kong's US$150 million Euro floating rate note issue has been allotted, arranger LTCB Asia said on Tuesday.
The facility has a final maturity of five years. The issue was priced at par to float at 110 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 35 basis points, split 15 basis points for management and underwriting and 20 basis points for selling.
Joint lead managers with US$42 million each are LTCB International and Sanwa International.
Co-lead managers with US$10 million each are Daiwa Europe, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Standard Chartered Bank.
Co-managers with US$5 million each are BA Asia, HSBC Markets, ING Barings, Nippon Credit International HK, Sakura Finance Asia and SocGen.
Other co-managers with US$3 million each are BNP Hong Kong and BT Asia.
